APPROX-1.root_cause: Newton-Raphson approximation dip below 0.5 caused div_num_prod bits 46 and 45 to both be 0, putting bit 44 into mantissa[22] and decrementing exponent by only 1 instead of 2.
APPROX-1.remediation: Added explicit normalization branch in Stage 4 for div_num_prod < 0.5: mantissa from [43:21] and exp - 2.

APPROX-2.issue: RSQRT(0x7f7fffff) (max finite) 2x factor error (rel error was 99.99985%)
APPROX-2.root_cause: For max finite input, rsqrt_y_norm dipped slightly below 1.0 (0x7ffff4), so bit 23 was 0 and bit 22 was 1; unnormalized Stage 4 treated bit 22 as mantissa without exponent decrement.
APPROX-2.remediation: Added normalization branch in Stage 4 for rsqrt_y_norm < 1.0: mantissa shifted left by 1 and exp 125 - k.

APPROX-3.issue: RSQRT(-0) and negative subnormals returned +inf instead of -inf
APPROX-3.root_cause: Stage 0 special case logic assigned special_val_s0 = FP32_POS_INF unconditionally on zero FTZ operand without respecting a_sign.
APPROX-3.remediation: Updated special case to special_val_s0 = a_sign ? FP32_NEG_INF : FP32_POS_INF.

FLUSH_INTEGRATION_CONTRACT.issue: Declared default port value in REPORT was missing in RTL, posing integration risk for callers without .flush() port connection.
FLUSH_INTEGRATION_CONTRACT.remediation: Updated port declaration to 'input flush = 1'b0,' which supports both connected flush (.flush(flush)) and unconnected legacy instantiation without warnings.

known_limitations: Approximate math by contract: results match FP32 within ~0.11% for DIV and ~5.78e-6 for SQRT/RSQRT; bit-exactness is not intended.
External FMA (op 17) remains outside this module scope.
Target system is 512-dim Conformer/Transformer ASR (not KWT); whole-model end-to-end WER/CER is evaluated at graph integration, not standalone core.
No physical STA synthesis or board deployment performed in this logic simulation task.
